background_stochastic_floor.interpretation: Common-random-number recurrence across adjacent low-rate cells identifies a background stochastic ecology branch distinct from the rate-linked capital-exhaustion branch.

growth_ruin_pattern.interpretation: Mobilization initially increases organizational stock and fielded force while consuming runway. Once the capital branch becomes common, unconditional organizational stock falls sharply despite larger cumulative recruitment.

contract_consistent_verdict.reason_no_zero_collapse_band: The model has a background stochastic-collapse floor even at zero recruitment; the frozen analyzer therefore correctly returns no highest zero-collapse rate.
contract_consistent_verdict.cause_specific_capital_branch_observatio: Capital collapse first appears at recruitment multiplier 0.10 (1/24), rises to 4/24 at 0.1125, 6/24 at 0.125, 12/24 at 0.15, 22/24 at 0.20, and 24/24 at 0.25. This is descriptive cause resolution, not a retroactively defined universal threshold.

cross_experiment_synthesis: The result independently replicates the previously observed high-rate metabolic ceiling on a larger 24-seed, 12-rate fresh block.
SL4 supplies the exact local capital-conversion accounting mechanism beneath the frontier.
The independent 960-trajectory recruitment x fielding x capital assay showed the same resource-strain architecture with matched monotonicity and strong predictive compression.
The 12-seed pressure-regeneration phase map and 24-seed compensatory-recruitment confirmation both independently reproduced near-perfect recruitment-versus-capital anticorrelation.
The evidence supports a regeneration-runway tradeoff and mobilization leverage/ruin frontier; it does not support a unique interior optimum or a universal calibrated threshold.
guard: Synthetic Pineland mechanism result only. Recruitment-rate and capital scales are not historically calibrated and do not prescribe real insurgent behavior.
